concerns.text: Constitution Principle VI (Human‑Subject Anonymity) requires a task that strips or hashes personally identifying information (e.g., Prolific IDs) from `data/raw/real_ratings.csv` before any analysis. No task in the current list performs this anonymisation step.

Constitution Principle III (Data Hygiene) mandates that every dataset be checksummed and the checksum recorded. There is no task that computes or records checksums for any data files (stimuli, ratings, processed outputs).
